The pin itself: mirror.gcr.io answers the tag 18 with exactly that digest, the manifest is an OCI image index carrying linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 among its platforms, and its amd64 config holds PG_MAJOR=18, PG_VERSION=18.6-1.pgdg13+2, PGDATA=/var/lib/postgresql/18/docker.
proof.negativeControl: Two. (1) The A3 case below: the same manifest with its volume back at /var/lib/postgresql/data refused to start, so a green client is not a green light for any mount. (2) An earlier attempt at that case, with db at 2 CPU and no client, never ran a container at all: the namespace's admission refused the Job because no container of its pod template requested four processors. The refusal was read, the case re-run at 4 CPU, and it is recorded here because a driver that had not read its own create errors would have reported a case it never ran.

proof.criterion: A3. A run with the old mount path on the 18 image is refused, quoted as the negative control.
proof.surface: The same Kubernetes Job surface, one Job identical to the stage-1 Job but with its volume at /var/lib/postgresql/data and no client container.
proof.observed: Job infra-741-t-negative-control-mp7fq: the db container terminated with exit code 1 and the Job reported 1 failed. Its log carries 'Error: in 18+, these Docker images are configured to store database data in a format which is compatible with "pg_ctlcluster"', then 'Counter to that, there appears to be PostgreSQL data in:' and, verbatim, '  /var/lib/postgresql/data (unused mount/volume)', then 'The suggested container configuration for 18+ is to place a single mount at /var/lib/postgresql'. This reproduces the implementer's negative control independently, from a driver of the tester's own.
proof.negativeControl: The four cases of the same two runs that differ from it only in the mount destination (stage1, casts, gomsg at /var/lib/postgresql or with no volume) each started and served select 1 with exit code 0, and the pg16 case started at /var/lib/postgresql/data with no refusal at all. So the refusal is the pairing of this image with that mount, and not the manifest, the cluster or the path alone.
